description: The bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of two different logical synthesis modules, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across four categories of complexity: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The horizontal axis represents the categories, while the vertical axis indicates the execution accuracy, measured in percentage. For the 'Simple' category, NatSQL has an execution accuracy of 60.21%, and TA-SQL has a slightly higher accuracy of 63.14%. In the 'Moderate' category, NatSQL's accuracy is 39.64%, and TA-SQL's is 48.60%. The 'Challenging' category shows NatSQL with an accuracy of 32.32% and TA-SQL with 36.11%. The 'Total' category combines the results, with NatSQL at 51.35% and TA-SQL at 56.19%. The bars are color-coded, with NatSQL represented in a lighter shade and TA-SQL in a darker shade. The chart does not indicate any sorting or emphasis on specific bars.
